theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_ims_density_series
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), ∑' r, (R r).measure U ≠ ∞ → ∃ η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n, (∀ᵐ x ∂μHE[n], HasSum (fun r => (R r).carrier.indicator (fun y => ((R r).mult y : ℝ) • (R r).orient y) x) (η x)) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => (R r).action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (∫ x, η x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n])
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
